description:
Deal combat damage using Obeka, triggering its ability, causing you to get at least four extra upkeep steps.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Smaug triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Repeat step 2 during each other extra upkeep step, creating at least four additional Treasures.
During your postcombat main phase, activate five Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{R}{R}.
Activate Aggravated Assault by paying {3}{R}{R}, causing you to untap all creatures you control and get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Repeat.

uses.name: Obeka, Splitter of Seconds
uses.cardState: without summoning sickness and with power 5 or greater
